Name: Wallet Tools
Author: deleted285543707
Description:
[color=#ffff00]*[/color]If you [color=#00ff00]like[/color] my [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] consider [color=#ff0000][size=3]Endorsing[/size][/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color]

[b]Wallet Tools[/b] frees up backpack space by moving your main tools into the Special Items & Powers tab. 

Your Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Watering Can, Pan, Milk Pail and Shears stay available when you need them. You can also call upon your Horse Flute (Left Ctrl + H) and Return Scepter (Left Ctrl + S) on demand with configurable hotkeys. Your Auto Petter now sits in the wallet and applies farm wide.

To use the forge for enhancements simply use your assigned hotkey and it will pull the tool out for enhancement. You can use the hotkeys to cycle between tools.

It uses customized logic taken from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21050]Automate Tool Swap[/url].

You can also use configurable hotkeys to use the tools manually.

Each tool can be toggled on or off individually in the GMCM options.

[size=4]Translations are [color=#ff0000]HIGHLY[/color] encouraged. There is an i18n folder.[/size]

[size=3]Currently Supported Languages:[/size]
[size=3]English[/size]
[size=3]Chinese[/size]
[size=3]Spanish[/size]

[size=4]Wallet Tools has [color=#00ff00][b]built in c[/b][/color][/size][size=4][color=#00ff00][b]ompatibility[/b][/color] with the following mods:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48774]Coin Collector Redux[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42725]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]:
Mount the tractor.
Press Q to select the previous tool.
Press E to select the next tool.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense: [/url]
Press Left Ctrl + F to open the Fashion Sense customization menu.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43007]The Timeless Pocket Watch: [/url]
Press Left Ctrl + T to activate or deactivate the watch. 
To put cogs into the stored watch, open your inventory, hold the Shift key, and right-click the cog.
Shift-right-clicking another stack of the same cog adds it to the cog already inside the watch.

Wallet Tools should also [color=#00ff00][u]automatically recognize[/u][/color] mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21507]Various Coal Ores[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies [/url]via GetBreakingTool through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions,[/url]
           
Wallet Tools has its own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] app.

All Hotkeys are configurable.

[color=#ff0000][size=4]Known Compatibility Issues:[/size][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842]Mail Services[/url]: when using upgrades through the mail. You will need to turn off mail return for tool upgrades.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39047]Instant Tool Upgrades For Costs[/url]: when having a tool returned and you do not have an open inventory slot the tool will disappear. 
[color=#ffff00][size=3]INSTEAD [/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3]use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47685]Instant Tool Upgrades Redux[/url]. The Redux is also fully cost configurable.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3]If you have a mod Wallet Tools does not work with you can request a compatibility addon to be made.[/size][/color]
